text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—Gaaaaaaaah!!
Defeat... Total defeat... El lost...!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Frustrating, so frustrating...! Frustrating, frustrating, frustrating!
And here El Condor Pasa is supposed to be the strongest in the world...!!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El-chan...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Still. But I will face it head-on.
El's weakness... and Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Your strength...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! El-chan...!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us shake hands, Spe-chan.
Bite back the frustration, and let us share a handshake of mutual respect.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —I'm so glad I got to race against you!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mm... yeah.
Me too, El-chan...!!
The two shared a firm, resolute handshake...
—And on the way home...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Good work out there
in the Japan Cup, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan...!
Were you watching, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
I watched it with my own two eyes from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And... I have been waiting right here
all this time for you to come.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you were waiting the whole...
Could it be, Grass-chan...!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...I know El's strength all too well.
Her proclaiming herself the strongest in the world is by no means an empty boast."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: “Yet, against that very El…… Spe-chan, you defeated her in a head-on clash.”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"I doubt there is anyone left
who would question your strength."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Therefore—I challenge you to a duel.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
As someone who, like you, aspires to reach
the end of the road known as racing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass-chan...!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The battleground is the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In that race where only the truly formidable gather, chosen by fan votes
from among the strongest Umamusume across both the Classic and Senior classes—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let's decide who's at the top, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!
And so, Special Week was set to challenge the "Monster," Grass Wonder, in the Arima Kinen...!
